items.source: Annotation at the field or method/constructor parameter level that injects the RSocket port that was allocated at runtime. Provides a convenient alternative for @Value("${local.rsocket.server.port}").
items.translation: 在字段或方法/构造函数参数级别注入运行时分配的 RSocket 端口的注解。为 `@Value("${local.rsocket.server.port}")` 提供了一种便捷的替代方案。
